title: Ride the Rails
theme: Trains: in the movies, in the parks and in Walt's backyard
intro: [excited] ALL ABOARD! Welcome to RIDE THE RAILS! Walt Disney loved trains more than almost anything, so today it's locomotives, monorails and one very special backyard railroad. [laughs] Choo choo!

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A shining vintage steam locomotive with red and gold trim pulling into a Victorian railway station at sunrise, puffing white steam, bunting on the platform and a clock tower beyond.

categories.title: Trains on Screen
categories.intro: Our film category: trains in Disney movies! [chuckles] Please keep your arms and legs inside the theater.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A circus train of brightly painted cars rolling through rolling green hills at dawn, with steam puffing out of a cheerful little locomotive.

clues.clue: In Dumbo, the circus travels on a cheerful little train with this name.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Casey Jr.! [excited] I think I can, I think I can! He gets the circus over that hill every time.

clues.clue: Judy Hopps rides a train from her small town into this big city.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Zootopia! The train even has tiny doors for tiny animals. [laughs] Brilliant.

clues.clue: At the start of Toy Story 3, Woody chases this train-robbing toy, called One-Eyed Bart.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mr. Potato Head! [chuckles] Doing his best villain voice with only one eye in.

clues.clue: In Disney's 2013 Western The Lone Ranger, this actor plays Tonto.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Johnny Depp! And the movie's big finale is a runaway train chase. [excited] Hi-yo, Silver!

clues.clue: In Disney's 1956 film The Great Locomotive Chase, Union raiders steal this famous Civil War locomotive.
clues.reveal: [dramatic pause] The correct answer is The General! It's based on a real 1862 raid. [chuckles] Fess Parker leads the raiders.

categories.title: Walt's Backyard Railroad
categories.intro: Before Disneyland, Walt built a railroad in his own backyard: the Carolwood Pacific. [whispers] His neighbors were VERY curious.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A small-scale steam locomotive on narrow tracks curving through a lush California backyard garden, a little red barn in the background and a tunnel mouth under a flower bed.

clues.clue: Walt Disney loved riding these so much that he built one big enough to sit on in his own backyard.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is trains! [excited] Walt sat right on top of the tiny cars and drove it himself.

clues.clue: Walt's backyard train ran through a 90-foot one of these under his wife Lillian's flower bed.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a tunnel! [laughs] Lillian said no trains on her flowers, so Walt went UNDER them.

clues.clue: Walt's barn, the control center of his backyard railroad, now stands in this Los Angeles park.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Griffith Park! [chuckles] Walt's Barn is open to visitors on some Sundays. Free admission, maximum nerd.

clues.clue: The Carolwood Pacific was named for the street Walt lived on in this wealthy Los Angeles neighborhood.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Holmby Hills! Carolwood Drive, Holmby Hills. [sarcastic] Fancy neighborhood, very loud backyard.

clues.clue: This Disney machinist, later an Imagineering legend, helped Walt build his backyard engine, the Lilly Belle.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Roger Broggie! [excited] He went on to build trains and monorails for the parks. Walt's ultimate train buddy.

categories.title: Next Stop!
categories.intro: It's a zoom category! We start WAY zoomed in on something from a Disney park railway. [dramatic pause] Name it before the picture zooms out.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A grand old railway station platform with a glossy steam engine, a streamlined monorail gliding overhead on a beam, a circus train in the distance, all in bright morning light.

clues.clue: This sleek, futuristic train glides through the parks on a single raised beam.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the monorail! [excited] Please stand clear of the doors... por favor manténganse alejados de las puertas.

clues.clue: Ride in a circus animal cage on this little Fantasyland train at Disneyland.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Casey Jr. Circus Train! It's been chugging since 1955. [laughs] Yes, you can ride in a monkey cage.

clues.clue: Riders on the Disneyland Railroad pass a giant diorama of this Arizona natural wonder.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Grand Canyon! [gasps] Painted red rock walls, a thunderstorm and wildlife. All in one tunnel.

clues.clue: Right after the canyon, the Disneyland Railroad travels back in time to this dinosaur diorama.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Primeval World! [laughs] Those dinosaurs first appeared at the 1964 World's Fair before moving to Disneyland.

media.prompt: Extreme close-up, Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. Prehistoric jungle diorama with ferns, steaming volcano, a towering long-necked dinosaur and a triceratops facing a predatory dinosaur under a stormy amber sky.

clues.clue: This ornate Victorian parlor car on the Disneyland Railroad is named after Walt's wife.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Lilly Belle! [whispers] Riding it is a rare treat, so if a conductor offers... SAY YES.

categories.title: Disneyland Railroad
categories.intro: Next we ride the real deal: the Disneyland Railroad and its cousin at Walt Disney World! [excited] Tickets, please!

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A Victorian red-brick train station at the entrance to a theme park with a big clock, flower beds and a steam engine waiting on the tracks, morning sun.

clues.clue: The Disneyland Railroad's first station sits right at the park entrance at the start of this street.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Main Street, U.S.A.! [chuckles] Arrive by train, just like the old days.

clues.clue: Besides Main Street, New Orleans Square and Tomorrowland, the Disneyland Railroad stops in this land.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mickey's Toontown! [laughs] The station there used to be called Fantasyland station.

clues.clue: The Walt Disney World Railroad's four steam engines were found working in this country.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mexico! [excited] They hauled sugar cane in the Yucatán before Disney brought them to Florida.

clues.clue: Disneyland Railroad's engine No. 1, the C. K. Holliday, is named for the founder of this famous railroad.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Santa Fe! [chuckles] The Atchison, Topeka and Santa Fe sponsored the railroad when Disneyland opened.

clues.clue: Disneyland Railroad's engine No. 5, added in 2005, honors this animator and fellow train fan.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ward Kimball! [excited] He had a full-size railroad in his OWN backyard. Walt had competition.

categories.title: Whistle Stop Emoji
categories.intro: Our fan category is all emoji! Each one is a Disney ride, train or movie with something on rails. [chuckles] Choo-choose wisely.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A rainbow of glowing soft-edged circles and stars floating above a curved railroad track at twilight, dreamy and playful, no symbols or letters.

clues.clue: 🚂🐘🎪 Hint: a baby elephant with big ears travels with the circus.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dumbo! [laughs] Ears that big, who needs a train? He can FLY.

clues.clue: 🦸‍♀️🚝💨🤸 Hint: a super mom stretches to stop a runaway train in this sequel.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Incredibles 2! [excited] Elastigirl on a motorcycle, chasing a train. Honestly? Goals.

clues.clue: 🚂🦒🦓🌍 Hint: Animal Kingdom's train that runs from Harambe to Conservation Station.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Wildlife Express Train! [excited] It even takes you past the backstage animal care buildings. A real behind-the-scenes ride.

clues.clue: ⛏️🚂🦌🏜️ Hint: Disneyland's long-gone Frontierland train ride through a wild nature land.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mine Train Through Nature's Wonderland! [sighs] It closed in 1977 to make way for Big Thunder Mountain Railroad.

clues.clue: 🌴🚂🏝️🗾 Hint: the jungle steam train that circles Adventureland at Tokyo Disneyland.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Western River Railroad! It even passes a prehistoric dinosaur scene, just like at Disneyland.
